results.pair_summary: Both documents define core Chron-LLM IR types (Event, Node, Edge) and WAL-to-Graph lifting logic. Doc A provides a comprehensive system architecture including control flow, fault handling, and LLM state management. Doc B focuses specifically on Graph data structures and algorithms, introducing optimizations like HealthyTable for causal lookups that are absent in Doc A.
results.integration_rationale: Doc A serves as the architectural source of truth for the Delta3 Kernel. Doc B contains critical implementation details (HealthyTable, optimized parent lookup) that improve graph construction efficiency but currently exist in isolation with slightly divergent type definitions. Merging B into A ensures a single canonical specification that aligns high-level control logic with low-level graph optimization strategies, eliminating semantic drift between documentation and module specs.
